root_cause: The router in attendance.routes.js applied a blanket middleware that only allowed COORDINATOR, HOD, ADMIN, and PRINCIPAL roles, preventing STUDENT access entirely.
student_ownership_logic: In getStudentHistory, the `studentId` from the URL parameter is forcibly overwritten by `req.user.scopeRef.refId` if the authenticated user has the 'STUDENT' role.
own_attendance_test: Passed. Students querying their own attendance history correctly fetch their own records.
cross_student_tampering_test: Passed. Any attempt by a Student to pass a different student's ID in the URL is overridden by their token's ID, preventing unauthorized access.
guest_lecture_attendance_result: Passed. Fetches Guest Lecture attendance correctly from AttendanceRecord and joins session info.
remedial_attendance_result: Passed. Fetches Remedial Class attendance correctly.
empty_state_result: Passed. An empty array is returned if no records exist, avoiding fake data generation.
coordinator_regression: Passed. Coordinator endpoints (e.g., /progress/all, /:referenceId) retain their original RBAC rules and function as before.
